surface: Octane-native DevTools plugin (not an upstream port): renders live runtime diagnostics into a TanStack Devtools host via @tanstack/devtools-event-client. P1 ships the Components tree + state inspector.
ssr: The plugin renders no anchor of its own; it is a client-only panel plugged into @octanejs/tanstack-devtools. Include it only in dev.
notes: Reads the dev-only globalThis.__OCTANE_DEVTOOLS__ hook (present only in profile/devtools builds).
